phase: 8 (part 1: the Streamlit app; Power BI is part 2, next session, with its own checks)
pre_registered: 2026-11-25, before any app code or snapshot. Choices made by the user: reports 2022-2026 with the incomplete period flagged; Streamlit Community Cloud from branch main; Power BI after the app.
scoring: Each dimension scores 1 only if all its checks pass; score = passing dimensions (0-5). A failure is fixed at its cause or reported as a failure; criteria are not loosened after results are seen.

dimensions.name: Every number is right
checks: Every snapshot file matches the manifest (rows, sha256, unique sorted key) and the manifest's source checksums match the committed results files
Snapshots built from the database equal separate SQL run by the verifier, cell for cell (local, recorded in dashboards/local_checks.json)
Snapshots copied from results files equal those files, cell for cell
Every number the app shows, read from the rendered pages (Streamlit AppTest), equals the verifier's own value at the shown precision

dimensions.name: Honest and safe
checks: The app never calls the Claude API or a database: no anthropic or psycopg import, no key or connection string, and it runs with neither installed
Every page that shows assistant answers says they are recorded replays, with the model, date and cost of each
Pages state: late 2026 is incomplete; accuracy was measured on 2022-2024; Phase 7 scored 4/5; Phase 7b labels came from an AI, with no human check; report counts are not failure rates
No personal data: snapshot text passes the contact-detail check; the memory page refuses phone numbers and e-mail addresses and keeps memory per visitor only

dimensions.name: Reproducible
checks: python -m dashboards.export_snapshots run twice gives byte-identical files equal to the committed ones (local)
CI installs only app/requirements.txt (exact pins) on a clean Python 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14 and runs the app tests

dimensions.name: Works and can fail
checks: Every page renders with no exception under AppTest, including every product, every recorded answer and the memory actions
The verifier catches at least 6 planted bugs (a changed number, a stale snapshot, a missing caption, a page error, an API import, a wrong checksum)
Phone width: no page needs sideways scrolling at 375 px (local browser check, screenshot)

dimensions.name: Live
checks: The deployed app on Streamlit Community Cloud loads every page, shows the manifest's data checksum, and passes the smoke check against its public URL (evidence committed)

not_in_scope: no live model calls in the cloud; no database in the cloud; Power BI (part 2)
